profile_text.body:
Dell Technologies is a public company, traded as DELL, that was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Round Rock, Texas. Its website describes it as a provider of technology solutions, services and support, selling laptops, touch screen PCs, desktops, servers, storage, monitors, gaming hardware and accessories. The site also promotes a student offer on an eligible XPS model DX13260, described as featherlight with all-day battery and a touchscreen, with student savings from $599, valid until 11/2/26 at 7am CST, open to high school students 16 and older and college students at degree granting schools who join Dell Rewards or are current members and verify student status.

The harvested site text is retail and product oriented and makes no specific claims about artificial intelligence products or capabilities, so no AI offering is described there. The company's SEC filing identifier is 0001571996.

Dell's litigation exposure is recorded in Texas, with 94 cases. No lawsuits, no MCP servers and no individual products are otherwise listed for the company.
